name: What is trenchless sewer repair and how does it work?

mainEntity.name: What is trenchless sewer repair and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trenchless sewer repair is a method that minimizes digging by repairing or replacing pipes underground without excavating a long trench. Two common methods are pipe bursting and pipe lining. Pipe bursting involves pulling a new pipe through the old one, breaking the old pipe apart. Pipe lining involves inserting a resin-coated liner into the existing pipe, which then hardens to create a new pipe within the old one. This method saves landscaping and reduces disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trenchless sewer repair fixes or replaces pipes underground with minimal digging, using methods like pipe bursting or pipe lining.
